Contract ManageItemCRUDService::createItem(barcode: Integer,name: String,price: Real,stocknumber: Integer,orderprice: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		ob: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(i|i.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		ob.oclIsUndefined()
	postcondition:
		let newItem: Item in
		(newItem.oclIsNew() and

		newItem.Name = name and
		newItem.Price = price and
		newItem.StockNumber = stocknumber and
